author: fwyzard
body:
Update CUDA to version 13.4.2.

Major changes since CUDA 13.3:
  - add support for GCC 16 and clang 22 as host compilers;
  - the NVIDIA drivers are now packaged separately.

Patch the `cuda-gdb` shell script rather than adding a second wrapper.
title: Update CUDA to version 13.4.2
